assessment.observed_content: A side-scrolling underground game scene featuring a dark cavern, dirt platforms, an item hotbar at the top, and a small player character standing near a clay block text prompt.
assessment.before_after: The source and formatted/trusted images show virtually identical dark underground aesthetics with negligible differences in compression artifacts. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.6449); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: The high PSNX and minimal pixel error indicate a sound conversion that preserves visual fidelity without introducing noticeable compression degradation.
assessment.task_effect: Dark pixel-art caves, the lit area and HUD remain visible; a darkness flag must not remove this intentional style. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Low brightness and high dark-area ratio limit detailed analysis of fine pixel textures in shadowy regions.

assessment.observed_content: A bright urban rooftop perspective with white and grey buildings under a clear blue sky and a prominent yellow billboard.
assessment.before_after: Both panels present sharp, high-contrast city architecture with clear edges and vibrant lighting; differences are imperceptible visually. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.9296); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: The high sharpness and PSNR confirm that conversion accurately maintains high-frequency architectural details.
assessment.task_effect: White rooftops and geometric skyline remain suitable visual cues; brightness alone must not be treated as accidental overexposure. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: High brightness can obscure subtle specular highlights on white surfaces.

assessment.observed_content: A night scene featuring a towering structure resembling a lighthouse against a cloudy, moonlit sky with distant celestial bodies.
assessment.before_after: Source and formatted versions maintain identical dark atmospheres, moody lighting, and soft cloud textures with negligible error. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.3544); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: The quality decision to retain letterboxing and soft focus makes sense for atmospheric fidelity.
assessment.task_effect: The lighthouse silhouette and night atmosphere remain; apparent low sharpness is not sufficient evidence of corruption. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Low overall sharpness and high darkness restrict detailed textural assessment.

assessment.observed_content: An action scene of a character in armor holding a shield and weapon amidst a snowy mountainous environment with large dragon wings framing the view.
assessment.before_after: Images are visually identical, displaying high sharpness, detailed armor textures, and snowy terrain without discernible conversion artifacts. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.8133); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: The exceptionally high sharpness score and high PSNR reflect pristine preservation of complex visual elements.
assessment.task_effect: Character, shield, wing and snowy landscape remain; conversion retains the action/fantasy composition. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Motion blur and complex lighting dynamics can occasionally mask micro-details.

assessment.observed_content: A character in a dark suit viewed from behind standing before a grand classical European building at dusk, with fallen figures in the foreground.
assessment.before_after: Both panels exhibit identical lighting, shadow placement, and architectural detailing with no perceptible degradation. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 1.3656); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: The conversion maintains balance between dark foregrounds and warmly lit facades appropriately.
assessment.task_effect: Building, suited character and dusk lighting remain; no automatic shadow enhancement is justified. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Deep shadow regions hide costume textures of the foreground figures.

assessment.observed_content: A monochrome, silhouette-style side-scrolling scene featuring a small character facing a giant spider inside a cavernous, high-contrast environment.
assessment.before_after: Source and formatted images show identical stark black-and-white contrast, pillar structures, and atmospheric lighting. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.7079); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: Preserving the stark high-contrast aesthetic is essential for this distinctive artistic style.
assessment.task_effect: The monochrome silhouette composition remains; low texture is intentional style rather than an empty image. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Extreme contrast limits intermediate grayscale gradations.

assessment.observed_content: A rural medieval village setting showing three characters (including a child and a witcher-like figure) conversing near wooden huts and a cart.
assessment.before_after: The source and formatted images show minor pixel differences around foliage and wooden textures, though overall composition is well-preserved. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 2.5226); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: A slightly lower PSNR indicates mild quantization during conversion, but visual integrity remains acceptable.
assessment.task_effect: Rural architecture, character grouping and green/brown palette remain, while older source textures cannot be recovered. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Lower resolution scaling and compression can soften facial features and distant textures.

assessment.observed_content: A western-themed action shot featuring a cowboy firing a revolver with muzzle flash and smoke, accompanied by another character on a wooden porch.
assessment.before_after: Both panels display identical smoke particle effects, lighting, and western attire textures with high fidelity. Pixel differences are nonzero (RMS 0.5342); similarity of the displayed previews is not byte equality or a full-resolution equivalence proof.
assessment.quality_decision: High PSNR confirms that dynamic elements like smoke and muzzle flash are preserved without excessive artifacting.
assessment.task_effect: Western clothing, firearms, smoke and lighting remain; a single screenshot does not represent every scene in the game. Retrieval relevance was not benchmarked by this comparison.
assessment.limitations: Dense smoke obscuring parts of the frame reduces background visibility.
